$comment: Limits for an assistant working in this project. The deny list and the
hook are two independent mechanisms, and `nrw` refuses the same
actions from the inside when NRW_AGENT=1 -- because an instruction to a
model is a request, and only a hook is a limit.
The hook refuses: promote; curating fits (nrw fit star, unstar, discard,
restore, delete); nrw isaac push and --upload; nrw aure run without
--dry-run; nrw experiment assign, release, and --write; nrw sample reset
without --dry-run; init --nested; any --force; and every nrw tiled
command, and Tiled's own command line. `nrw agent guard --command
'...'` says what it would do with any command.
promote and curation: which fit is the answer, and which are good, are
a person's decisions, and the reason recorded is what a reader needs.
push and --upload: a record on a shared portal is not straightforwardly
retractable.
--force: every forcing flag here exists because a check said no.
Tiled: every command acts with the person's login, which the Tiled
client keeps in its own cache. Claude's file tools may not read that
cache, and `nrw agent run` gives each session no login at all: no
TILED_API_KEY, and an empty cache of the session's own.
Edit this file if you want an assistant to have more room. It is yours.
